subject: claw-code-agent
title: proprietary prompt strings and Claude branding shipped verbatim
evidence: src/prompt_constants.py:46-49 ('You are Claude Code, Anthropic's official CLI for Claude.'); src/agent_slash_commands.py:1886,1990 (Claude Code sticker/guest-pass commands)
